mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0% and trending downward.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts central bank easing and corporate cost-cutting, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE has been above 4.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a central bank response and subsequent equity market rebound over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side slowdown (INDPRO growth below 0.5% annually), a concurrent decline in GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%) signals a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in economic deterioration.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO annual growth < 0.5% and GDPC1 annual growth < 1.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% and GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates improving consumer confidence and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to near-term demand signals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST shows a positive trend (3-month moving average increase).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market deterioration, which triggers a policy response and subsequent equity market rebound over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase (as indicated by RSAFS growth above 2.0% annually), strong retail sales signal robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS annual growth exceeds 2.0%.
